_comment: Tool-facing hardware/address declaration for the Namco Galaxian board (parent set `galaxian`).
Galaxian/Scramble family (MAME src/mame/galaxian/galaxian.cpp), Namco base hardware -- direct port
reads + single-byte latches (NO PPI), custom discrete sound (galaxian_a.cpp, no sound CPU). Read from
(galaxian)@3069, GAME()@16795 (ROT90), gfx layouts@7391; galaxian.h timing@30-56; and galaxian_v.cpp:
Numbers are decimal (JSON has no 0x); '_hex'/'_note' fields are annotations the loader ignores.
controlByte=0xAF is MEASURED (games/galaxian/rom/maincpu.bin byte 0 = XOR A). Input idle values below
are MEASURED from a MAME golden run (SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy, fresh -cfg_directory, -noreadconfig):
in0=0x00, in1=0x00, in2=0x04, control=0xAF, Z80 reset regs -- == the DIPSETTING defaults, and dsw0 is
verified by the config-probe. Landmarks still EMPTY (boot-init/first-vblank cycles come with the

screen._note: galaxian_base set_raw(PIXEL_CLOCK=18.432MHz, HTOTAL=1152, HBEND 0, HBSTART 768, VTOTAL 264, VBEND 16, VBSTART 240) -> visible 256x224. ROT90 (portrait). XSCALE=3 is an internal horizontal render scale; the state/tile model is native 256 wide. galaxian.cpp:7498-7501, galaxian.h:41-56.

_watchdog_note: 0x7800 mirror 0x07FF is a READ (watchdog reset_r), not a write; reset_r pets the dog and returns 0xFF (unmap_value_high). The 0x7800 WRITE is the sound pitch_w. galaxian_map_base@1766, galaxian_map_discrete@1743.
_inputs_note: Galaxian has NO standalone DSW port: the dip bits are interleaved into IN1 (Coinage 0xC0) and IN2 (Bonus 0x03, Lives 0x04). All input bits are IP_ACTIVE_HIGH (pressed reads 1, idle 0). Idle values below MEASURED from a MAME golden config-probe (in0=0x00, in1=0x00, in2=0x04) and equal the DIPSETTING defaults (galaxian.cpp:3069-3106).

IN0._bits: b0=COIN1 b1=COIN2 b2=LEFT(2way) b3=RIGHT(2way) b4=BUTTON1 b5=DSW Cabinet(0=upright default) b6=SERVICE b7=SERVICE1. idle 0x00. ✓ MEASURED 0x00.

IN1._bits: b0=START1 b1=START2 b2=LEFT(cocktail) b3=RIGHT(cocktail) b4=BUTTON1(cocktail) b5=unused b6-7=DSW Coinage(default 0x00=1C/1C). idle 0x00. ✓ MEASURED 0x00.

IN2._bits: b0-1=DSW Bonus_Life(default 0x00=7000) b2=DSW Lives(default 0x04=3) b3=unused b4-7=unused. idle = Lives-default 0x04. ✓ MEASURED 0x04.

dsw0._hex_expected: 0x04 -- Lives DIP default (3). Galaxian has NO standalone DSW port; IN2 (Bonus b0-1 + Lives b2) is the config-probe port most able to corrupt a golden. ✓ MEASURED 0x04 (dsw0_verified by the mame_golden config-probe at t=0).

_controlByte_hex: 0xAF -- ROM[0x0000] first byte (XOR A at reset; then LD (0x7001),A to clear irq_enable, JP 0x1A55). MEASURED from games/galaxian/rom/maincpu.bin byte 0. Non-0xFF, so it distinguishes a real ROM read from this board's 0xFF unmap_value_high float.

z80Reset._hex: MAME Z80 reset: AF=0x0040 (Z flag set), IX=IY=0xFFFF, rest 0 -- same for every MAME Z80

interrupt._note: vblank_interrupt_w asserts INPUT_LINE_NMI only while irq_enable_w's D0 latch (0x7001) is set; clearing it clears the line. m_irq_line defaults to INPUT_LINE_NMI. galaxian.cpp:761-767,779-787, galaxian.h:435.
